pom.bl_intro: Let's race our balloons up to the big cloud! Every right answer is a puff of hot air.
pom.bl_win: You reached the big cloud! What a race!
pom.qc_same: Which card has the same number?
pom.qc_onemore: One more comes. How many now?
pom.qc_onefewer: One goes away. How many now?
pom.qc_tip_touch: Count them slowly. Touch each one once.
pom.qc_tip_quick: Look for little groups. Twos and threes!
pom.qc_tip_onemore: Count them all, then count one more.
pom.qc_tip_match: Match them up, one and one. Which side has some left over?
pom.qc_tip_track: Count up from one. Which number do you say later?
pom.qc_tip_next: Say the numbers. What do you say next?
pom.qc_tip_none: None means nothing at all. Zero!
pom.qc_tip_look: Look at the number. Now count the dots.

mumba.hh_intro: Our baby is hungry! Feed it the berries it wants.
mumba.hh_one: Which plate has this many berries?
mumba.hh_two: Find two plates that make this many!
mumba.hh_tip_one: Count the berries on each plate, slowly.
mumba.hh_tip_two: Look at the places. How many more does it need?
mumba.hh_end: Its tummy is full! Off to the Critter Garden it goes!

bim.bb_intro: Smash the brick with the answer! Clear the whole wall before it comes down to the line.
bim.bb_yes2: You found it! Look at those bricks fly!
bim.bb_show: Here it is. Smash this one!
bim.bb_close: The wall is getting close to the line! Quick!
bim.bb_end: The wall is gone! What a brick smasher!
bim.bb_lost: Oh no, the wall reached the line! Let's try again.
bim.bb_q_next: What comes next? Find it on the wall.
bim.bb_q_before: What comes just before? Find it on the wall.
bim.bb_q_between: Which number is missing? Find it on the wall.
bim.bb_q_count: Count on in the same jumps. Which brick comes next?
bim.bb_q_dots: How many dots? Smash that number.
bim.bb_q_which: Which number is it? Find it on the wall.
bim.bb_q_blocks: What number do the blocks show?
bim.bb_q_sum: Work it out, then smash the answer!
bim.bb_q_take: Take it away, then smash the answer!
bim.bb_q_even: Even numbers! Smash an even one.
bim.bb_q_odd: Odd numbers! Smash an odd one.
bim.bb_q_words: Read the number, then find it on the wall.
bim.bb_q_tens: How much are all those tens?
bim.bb_tip_next: Say the numbers, then one more.
bim.bb_tip_count: Look at the jumps between the numbers.
bim.bb_tip_dots: Count them one by one. A full frame is ten.
bim.bb_tip_blocks: Each long one is a ten. Count the tens, then the ones.
bim.bb_tip_more10: Ten more is the brick just below.
bim.bb_tip_less10: Ten less is the brick just above.
bim.bb_tip_tens: Change the tens first, then the ones.
bim.bb_tip_ones: Add the ones. The tens stay the same.
bim.bb_tip_even: Even numbers end in zero, two, four, six or eight.
bim.bb_tip_odd: Odd numbers end in one, three, five, seven or nine.
bim.bb_tip_words: Hundreds first, then the tens, then the ones.
bim.qp_turned: Which is the same shape, turned?
bim.qp_in: Find the Peep in the box.
bim.qp_on: Find the Peep on the box.
bim.qp_under: Find the Peep under the box.
bim.qp_above: Find the Peep above the box.
bim.qp_below: Find the Peep below the box.
bim.qp_beside: Find the Peep beside the box.
bim.qp_next_to: Find the Peep next to the box.
bim.qp_in_front_of: Find the Peep in front of the box.
bim.qp_behind: Find the Peep behind the box.
bim.qp_between: Find the Peep between the boxes.
bim.qp_basket: Which one goes in this basket?
bim.qp_corners: Which shape has this many corners?
bim.qp_fits: Which shape fits in the empty place?
bim.qp_pattern: Which one is a repeating pattern?
bim.qp_sticks: Which shape can you make with these sticks?
bim.qp_join: Put these pieces together. What do they make?
bim.qp_smallestpieces: Which pie has the smallest pieces?
bim.qp_sides: Which shape has this many sides?
bim.qp_halfcircle: Which one is a half circle?
bim.qp_quartercircle: Which one is a quarter circle?
bim.qp_pieces: How many pieces like this make the whole?
bim.qp_equalsquares: Which rectangle is split into equal squares?
bim.qp_morestars: How many more stars than hearts?
bim.qp_tip_sides: Look at the sides and the corners. Follow the edge all the way around.
bim.qp_tip_corners: Touch each corner as you count. Go all the way around.
bim.qp_tip_position: Look where the Peep is. Look at the box too.
bim.qp_tip_colour: Look at the colour of the things in the basket.
bim.qp_tip_size: Compare their sizes. Some take up more space.
bim.qp_tip_pattern: Say the pattern out loud. Listen for the part that repeats.
bim.qp_tip_count: Touch each thing you are counting, just once.
bim.qp_tip_sticks: Each stick can make a side. Try one stick for each side.
bim.qp_tip_join: Try turning the pieces in your mind. Fit their straight edges together.
bim.qp_tip_parts: Think about the whole. Are its parts the same size?
bim.qp_tip_graph: Start at the same place. Count one space for each thing.
bim.dk_intro: Hit the target with the right answer, and SPLASH! In they go!
bim.dk_end: Everybody in! What a splashing day!
bim.qp_onecoin: One coin for each toy. How many coins?
bim.qp_coinworth: How many rupees is this coin?
bim.qp_worthmost: Which one is worth the most?
bim.qp_tip_coin: Look at the number on the coin.
bim.qp_tip_skip: They are all the same. Count on by that number each time.
bim.qp_tip_worth: Look at the numbers, not how big it looks.
bim.qp_tip_money: Start with the biggest one, then count on.
bim.qp_tip_change: Start at the price and count up to what Pom paid.
bim.qp_tip_solid: Is it round? Does it have flat sides? Does it come to a point?
bim.qp_tip_flat: A solid shape you could pick up and hold. A flat one is like a drawing.
bim.qp_tip_faces: A face is a flat side. Count the flat sides.
bim.qp_tip_pairs: Make pairs. Is one left over?
bim.qp_tip_rows: Count one row. Then count how many rows there are.
bim.qp_tip_length: They all start at the same place. Look where each one ends.
bim.qp_tip_height: They stand on the same ground. Look at the tops.
bim.qp_first: Which one is first in the line?
bim.qp_second: Which one is second in the line?
bim.qp_third: Which one is third in the line?
bim.qp_howmanymore: How many more? Look at the graph.
bim.qp_each: How many are in each group?
bim.qp_tip_groups: Every group has the same number.

digsy.cd_intro: Blocks are falling into our well! Tap a column to move the block there. Land it on the block that makes the number on our sign, and they squish away. Clear the whole well!
digsy.cd_tip: Look at the filled places. How many more do you need?
digsy.cd_yes2: You made the number on our sign!
digsy.cd_together: These two parts would make the number on our sign.
digsy.cd_end: We cleared the whole well! Wonderful adding!
digsy.cd_stuck: Oh, that one doesn't make it, so it stays on top. Here comes its partner. Fix it!
digsy.cd_full: That column is full! It bounced off.
